name: ui-craft
description: Design-engineering skills and local MCP quality gates for AI coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Design engineering for AI coding agents: build interfaces, establish design tokens, review accessibility, and refine typography, layout, motion, and responsive behavior. Includes focused workflows and a local MCP server for deterministic design-quality checks. Requires local execution and Node.js 20 or newer; the MCP server is installed from npm on first use. No hosted account is required.
defaultPrompt: Build a dashboard with clear hierarchy and accessible interactions.
Review my interface for accessibility and generic design patterns.
Establish a consistent token system for this project.
